rpk: Learners heard French around them (Ghana is surrounded by francophone countries) and learned greetings, family, environment and shopping vocabulary in JHS 1-2 French.
starter: Greet learners in French ('Bonjour la classe!') and sing a short French greeting song.
Show flashcards with French words and pictures linked to today's topic; ask 'Que voyez-vous?' (What do you see?)

ACTIVITY 4 (Performance – 3 min): 2-3 pairs perform the dialogue/answers; class applauds; teacher highlights good French.
plenary: Exit question: every learner says one French word/sentence from today.

Preview next French lesson.
assessment: Class exercises; project work; SBA; BECE-style

rpk: Learners heard French around them (Ghana is surrounded by francophone countries) and learned greetings, family, environment and shopping vocabulary in JHS 1-2 French.
starter: Greet learners in French ('Bonjour la classe!') and sing a short French greeting song.
Show a short recorded or teacher-modelled dialogue linked to today's topic; ask 'Que voyez-vous?' (What do you see?)

NEW TODAY (Semaine 9): Aujourd'hui nous écouter, comprendre et réagir à une conversation ou une présentation dans laquelle des gens s’expriment sur le monde d’hier et celui d’aujourd’hui. (Réception orale / Compréhension de l’oral)
Drill 4-6 new French words chorally (repeat, gesture, point).
main: ACTIVITY 1 (Model – 5 min): Teacher models the language using a short recorded or teacher-modelled dialogue – écouter, comprendre et réagir à une conversation ou une présentation dans laquelle des gens s’expriment sur le monde d’hier et celui d’aujourd’hui. (Réception orale / Compréhension de l’oral)
ACTIVITY 2 (Répétition guidée – 5 min): Whole class repeats; rows/groups take turns; teacher corrects pronunciation.
ACTIVITY 3 (Pair/Group practice – 5 min): Learners act out the dialogue in groups (jeu de rôle) using the new words (b9.7.3).
ACTIVITY 4 (Performance – 3 min): 2-3 pairs perform the dialogue/answers; class applauds; teacher highlights good French.
plenary: Exit question: every learner says one French word/sentence from today.
Quick game: 'Montrez-moi...' (point to flashcard) for recall.
Homework: teach today's French words to someone at home; write them twice in the exercise book.
Preview next French lesson.
assessment: Class exercises; project work; SBA; BECE-style
